Definition: from G3722; in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break:--early.
BiblicalUsage: This word, meaning early, does not occur in the Greek New Testament at all. No form of it stands in any verse of the SBL text, so there is no passage to show for it here.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe honesty about this word matters: it stands in the lexicon as an adjective for early, but it does not occur in the Greek New Testament, and I will not invent a verse for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
